title: Impact of Good and Bad Deeds
summary: Good or bad deeds impact others, affecting ongoing rewards or sins.
translation: In life, we perform many good deeds that remain even after us, and others adopt them as virtuous actions. This chain continues to be recorded in our Book of Deeds as long as the action is performed, if it is good. For example, if we taught someone the Quran or helped someone become a Hafiz (memorizer of the Quran), and they in turn teach others or help them become Hafiz, then as long as people continue to become Hafiz through any link in this chain, the reward will continue to reach us. But the same is true for bad deeds. If a person does wrong and others follow, that sin remains as well. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Whoever initiates a good practice in Islam, it will be rewarded and the reward of those who follow it will not diminish." Scholars say that those who obey later still get the reward based on their righteous actions, and the one who invites to good gets rewarded for their effort. Similarly, whoever initiates wrongdoing will accrue sin as others follow, like the sin of murder is upon Qabil, the first murderer, as narrated by Abdullah bin Masud (may Allah be pleased with him) from the Prophet (peace be upon him). He said that every unjust killing brings a share of its sin to the first son of Adam, Qabil, because he was the first to initiate killing. The story is also in the Quran that Qabil killed Habil. This hadith warns against starting any such work that is against Shariah because this sin keeps accumulating to the initiator. Today, we share posts without verifying or make videos viral regardless of their truth or Shariah permissibility. This could cause us sin even after we pass away. Therefore, creating good deeds is virtuous, while initiating bad deeds is dangerous and must be avoided. May Allah protect us all.
